behavior.arguments: rdi = base pointer. When the qword field [rdi+0xb0] is 0, the result is 0. Otherwise the result is 1 iff the gate byte [rdi+0xb8] is 0, else 0.

edges.null_pointer: pointer field 0, gate byte 0 -> 0; the gate byte is never read on this path.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; one forward branch, no calls: endbr64; xor %eax,%eax; cmpq $0x0,0xb0(%rdi); je 0x53d1faa; cmpb $0x0,0xb8(%rdi); sete %al; ret.
behavior.return_rule: eax is exactly 0 or 1 on every path: xor zeroes it first, and sete writes only %al, but the prior xor guarantees the upper bytes are 0, so the returned eax is a clean boolean.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Two R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in .rela.dyn name this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries). They are reported as a slot list only; no meaning is claimed for the table they belong to.
